emailTemplates.name: Welcome Email
emailTemplates.subject: Welcome to {{app_name}}, {{user_name}}!
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{user_name}},

Welcome to {{app_name}}! Your account has been created successfully.

Your username: {{username}}

Get started by visiting your dashboard.

Best regards,
The {{app_name}} Team

emailTemplates.name: Password Reset
emailTemplates.subject: Password Reset Request - {{app_name}}
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{user_name}},

We received a request to reset your password.

Click the link below to set a new password:
{{reset_link}}

This link expires in {{expiry_minutes}} minutes.

If you did not request this, please ignore this email.

Best regards,
The {{app_name}} Team

emailTemplates.name: Notification
emailTemplates.subject: [{{app_name}}] {{notification_title}}

emailTemplates.name: Invite
emailTemplates.subject: You've been invited to {{app_name}}
emailTemplates.body:
Hi,

{{inviter_name}} has invited you to join {{app_name}}.

Click below to accept your invitation:
{{invite_link}}

This invitation expires on {{expiry_date}}.

Best regards,
The {{app_name}} Team
